title: From Signals to Transfer: A Factorised Study of Probe-Based Uncertainty Estimation in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.27679v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Probe-based uncertainty estimation (UE) has emerged as a prominent approach to detect hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) by learning uncertainty from internal model signals. Yet, recent methods vary simultaneously across feature design, training data construction, and evaluation setting, obscuring what actually drives performance. To address this issue, we propose a factorised study of probe-based UE under matched conditions. Our results show that raw hidden states and attention features are difficult to outperform in-domain. However, under distribution shift, structured and compressed features are more robust, suggesting that in-domain performance alone is insufficient to measure progress. Furthermore, prompting and label construction significantly affect probe behaviour. translated_title: 从信号到迁移：大语言模型中基于探针的不确定性估计的因子化研究
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2606.27679v2，公告类型：replace-cross）：基于探针的不确定性估计（UE）已成为检测大语言模型（LLM）幻觉的重要方法，其通过从模型内部信号中学习不确定性来实现检测。然而，近期的方法在特征设计、训练数据构建和评估设置等多个方面同时存在差异，导致难以辨析真正驱动性能的因素。为解决这一问题，我们在匹配条件下对基于探针的不确定性估计进行了因子化研究。结果表明，原始隐藏状态和注意力特征在域内难以被超越；然而在分布偏移下，结构化和压缩特征更加鲁棒，这说明仅凭域内性能不足以衡量该领域的进展。此外，提示方式和标签构建会显著影响探针的行为。基于这些实证设计原则，我们构建了基准预训练的探针，其在开放式任务上仍保留了有用的判别信号。
tldr: 该论文通过对基于探针的不确定性估计进行匹配条件下的因子化研究，发现域内性能主要由原始隐藏状态等特征驱动，而结构化压缩特征在分布偏移下更为鲁棒，并据此构建了在开放式任务上仍保持判别能力的基准预训练探针。
en_tdlr: Through a factorised study of probe-based uncertainty estimation under matched conditions, this paper shows that in-domain performance favors raw hidden-state features while structured and compressed features are more robust under distribution shift, and builds benchmark-pretrained probes that retain discriminative signal on open-ended tasks.
